## What's changed

- Added Upscaling Auto Detect to test the server's Standard scaler, Vulkan path, and every bundled AI model, then recommend a safe starting configuration.
- Added Anime4K Balanced and Quality for animated video, plus ArtCNN Restore for denoising and sharpening compressed animation.
- Redesigned the Upscaling settings page with clearer mode and model selection, content-focused model groups, compatibility results, and visible fallback paths.
- Improved playback status so the active AI model and fallback behavior are easier to understand.
- Enabled headless NVIDIA Docker systems to use the NVIDIA EGL Vulkan driver automatically when the injected GLX Vulkan driver cannot initialize AI processing.
- Bundled and verified the expanded AI shader set in Docker and macOS builds.
- Removed the unnecessary Revoked players list from the paired-player settings page.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
